select * from ( select vfp.finprod_id finprodId, /*资产代码*/ vfp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, /*资产名称*/ fpt.type_1 assetTypeCode, /*资产类型*/ vfp.issuer issuer, /*发行人/管理人*/ vfp.ccy ccy, /*币种*/ -- decode('资产类型','项目类资产',(vfp.issue_amt)/10000,'') sumprice, /*发行规模*/ (vfp.issue_amt)/10000 sumprice, DATE_FORMAT(vfp.vdate, '%Y-%m-%d') vdate1, /*起息日*/ DATE_FORMAT(vfp.mdate, '%Y-%m-%d') mdate1, /*到期日*/ vfp.is_sus susYorN, /*永续*/ '' tradingtime, /*交易日历*/ vfp.profit_type profitType, /*收益类型*/ ext.IS_COMPOUND_INT compoundint, /*是否按日复利*/ vfp.bln_area blnArea, /*境内外*/ vfp.capi_income_feature priproflag, /*本金收益标志*/ '' raisetype, /*募集方式*/ vfp.finprod_market_id opmarketid, /*公开市场代码*/ '' isNonstandard, /*是否非标*/ case para.INT_ACCRUAL_MODE when '0' then '01' when '1' then '02' else null end transactiontype, /*交易方式*/ '' isExpectedprofit, /*是否有预期收益*/ vccr.basis basic, /*计息基础*/ (vccr.yield)*100 ratestr /*初始利率*/
from FIN_PRODUCT vfp left join fin_CASH_CALC_RULE vccr on vfp.finprod_id = vccr.finprod_id left join fin_CASH_PAY_RULE vcpr on vfp.finprod_id = vcpr.finprod_id left join fin_product_type fpt ON vfp.finprod_id = fpt.finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT_add ext on ext.finprod_id = vfp.finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION_PARA para on vfp.finprod_id = para.finprod_id where 1 = 1 AND vfp.finprod_type = 'F17' AND vfp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} ORDER BY vcpr.Eff_Date desc ) de limit 1

select * from (select (select a.pay_cycle from fin_CASH_PAY_RULE a left join FIN_CASH_INFO b on a.cash_id = b.cash_id left join FIN_PRODUCT c on a.finprod_id = c.finprod_id where c.finprod_id =#{finprodId} and b.cash_type_1 = '01' limit 1 ) retype, /*还本方式*/ fccr.accr_tday_rule jxyyrzz, /*计息营业日准则*/ vcpr.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, /*付息截止日营业日准则*/ vcpr.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, /*付息支付日营业日准则*/ case fci.cash_type_1 when '02' then vcpr.pay_cycle else '' end paycycle,/*付息频率*/ vcpr.calc_rule calcrule, /*推算方式*/ case vcpr.calc_rule when '03' then DATE_FORMAT(vcpr.first_pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') else '' end fpayDate /*首次付息日*/ from fin_CASH_PAY_RULE vcpr left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on vcpr.cash_id =fci.cash_id left join FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE fccr on vcpr.cash_id = fccr.cash_id left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on vcpr.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} ORDER BY vcpr.Eff_Date desc ) de limit 1
select DATE_FORMAT(fccr.eff_date,'%Y-%m-%d') efdate, (fccr.yield)*100 rate2 from fin_cash_calc_rule fccr left join fin_product fp on fccr.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId}

select DATE_FORMAT(fcp.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') jxdatestr, /*计息开始日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') jxdateend, /*计息结束日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') paydate, /*支付日*/ case when fcp.INT_PRIN_AMT=0 then 0 when fcp.INT_PRIN_AMT=null then 0 else (fcp.int_amt/fcp.INT_PRIN_AMT)*100 end byrate /*百元应计利息*/ from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fcp.cash_id = fci.cash_id left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and fci.cash_type_1 = '02'

select DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') jsdateend, /*计息截止日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') paydate, /*支付日*/ '' tqrmon, /*提前还本金额*/ fcp.prin_amt aqrmon, /*按期还本金额*/ fcp.is_pay_int israte, /*是否带息*/ fcp.int_amt yjrte /*应计利息*/ from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fcp.cash_id = fci.cash_id left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and fci.cash_type_1 = '01'

select distinct DATE_FORMAT(fcp.vdate, '%Y-%m-%d') jsdatestr, /*计息开始日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate, '%Y-%m-%d') jsdateend, /*计息结束日*/ DATE_FORMAT(fcp.pay_date, '%Y-%m-%d') paydate /*支付日*/ from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId}
